correctness.rationale: Exact lattice-height slicing gives L_J=sum_{j=0}^4 e_j F_j, with explicit polynomial F_j. All coefficients outside degree one are positive; [t]L_J=-Delta/30. Pair balancing is an exact polynomial difference. One-side-equal-one gives Delta<0. For product <=4928, the sorted-side inequalities prove an exhaustive 10618-case integer domain; the included exact verifier checks that its sole Delta>0 member is (7,8,8,11). Direct forward-difference reconstruction from lattice counts independently checks the critical coefficient. Normalized volume equals 24 times side-length product. The infinity of larger products does not affect the minimum.

value.rationale: The recently constructed join operation produces eventual Ehrhart coefficient negativity but its concrete r=100 cube example provides no sharp size. Here a natural four-parameter orthotope family is classified coefficientwise, the smallest negative member is uniquely determined by normalized volume, and an exact complementary-pair balancing threshold explains the nontrivial anisotropy. This is a natural finite minimum benchmark and structural sign law, rather than a decorative parameter choice, table repetition or rebranding of the general join formula.
